description: This file contains platform-specific functions for identifying partitions, verifying images, and performing upgrades in an embedded Linux environment, specifically for OpenWrt on ath25 hardware.

methods.name: platform_find_partitions
methods.description: Finds and outputs information about partition layout from /proc/mtd.

methods.name: platform_find_kernelpart
methods.description: Identifies the kernel partition from provided partition info.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Verifies whether a given image file is valid based on its magic bytes and checksum.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs the firmware upgrade process by writing image data to appropriate memory partitions.
